Your details

Segoe UI isn't installed on this device, so a similar font is used. For an exact match, make your signature on a Windows PC.

Faded text is example text and is replaced as you type.

  1. Outlook: File › Options › Mail › Signatures › New, then paste (Ctrl+V) or use the picture button to insert the PNG.
  2. Gmail: Settings › See all settings › Signature › Create new, then use the image button to upload the PNG.
